note_en: 又 A 又 B links two qualities that are both true at once: 又快又稳 "both fast and smooth." English just says "fast and smooth," but Chinese repeats 又 before each adjective, and neither 又 can be dropped; the text also uses it for 又安静又舒适 "quiet and comfortable." Its formal cousin 既…又… appears too: 既省时间又省住宿费 "saves both time and hotel costs."
